```python
import polars as pl

# Sample long-format data
df = pl.DataFrame({
    'date': ['2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-02', '2024-01-02', '2024-01-02'],
    'city': ['New York', 'Los Angeles', 'Chicago', 'New York', 'Los Angeles', 'Chicago'],
    'temperature': [32, 65, 28, 35, 68, 30]
})

# Reshape from long to wide
wide_df = df.pivot(index='date', columns='city', values='temperature')

print(wide_df)
```
